description: Lists current and announced service changes in a city network, such as closed stations, skipped stops or diversions, for every route or for one route by code, name or service. plan_journey, place_departures and route_details already include the changes on the routes they use.

city.description: City network from find_places or list_cities, such as Lahore, Attock or Rawalpindi.

route.description: Route code, name or service. Leave out for every change in the city.

name: service_notices
title: Service changes
